label: General
cardNote: 🧭 The broad view: experience, tools, and selected work
headline: From understanding the problem
to building something that works in practice.
summary: Since 2009, I have worked on both independent and team projects: web services, desktop tools, and devices where the software and hardware had to be built together. I usually join while the requirements are still taking shape and stay involved through implementation, debugging, and delivery.

freelance: Built independent projects across Windows, Linux, web, data processing, and automation, from understanding the need through implementation and delivery.
When a project included custom hardware, I worked on the board, device interface, and device software alongside the user application.
security: Performed security analysis and penetration testing for government infrastructure, investigated vulnerabilities, and wrote patches for some of them.
Delivered findings with a repeatable example, a practical fix, and a way for the infrastructure team to check the result independently.
company: Co-founded a software company and worked on design, implementation, integration problems, and project delivery.
Built mobile and web applications with NoSQL databases and continued the remaining projects until the company’s commitments were complete.
